hypothesis: A rollout continuation in which each player keeps an independently stratified suit mapping for the complete hidden-world trajectory will estimate top-policy root decisions more faithfully than changing network orientation at every simulated decision. The independent confirmation panel must use the same role-separated policy family so discovery and confirmation evaluate one coherent method.

dependency_and_selection_rule.rule: Use root symmetries 120 in both actors if and only if the completed root-120 actor holdout has authoritative promotion_gate_passed=true after hardened raw-input revalidation. Otherwise use root symmetries 20 in both actors. If the parent test is operationally invalid or incomplete, do not start this test.

changes_as_one_coherent_method: playout_sample changes from 2 to 4: each player receives an independently stratified suit mapping that remains fixed through the complete sampled trajectory
policy_prefix_mode changes from 2 to 3: the fresh trusted-prefix confirmation panel uses the same role-separated trajectory policy family
unchanged: root policy and root suit ensemble selected by the parent-test rule
512 primary worlds and 512 fresh confirmation worlds
top-five, two-percent policy prefix and all practical/evidence gates
ply-14 rollout start, uniform hidden-world sampling, objective mode 0, and exact one-card terminal solution
all semantic, draw-variant, planner, recursive replan, and bounded-late additions remain disabled
candidate_definition.candidate_width: Only the maintained top-policy prefix is evaluated; this experiment does not scan every legal move.
candidate_definition.compute_class: Modes 2 and 4 both use one network forward per downstream decision. Role separation changes mapping coherence, not requested world count or root width.

source.compiler: gcc on one pinned ubuntu-24.04 build runner
source.single_binary_requirement: Build and hash one portable arena artifact once, then distribute that exact artifact to every shard.
source.runtime_provenance_requirement: Every raw shard must bind this plan SHA-256, selected parent-result SHA-256, source commit, arena SHA-256, model SHA-256, exact actor specifications, seed, pair range, rounds, and thread count.

prior_evidence.status: No retained direct 4+3 versus 2+2 strength A/B exists. Earlier qualitative position review was mixed and is neither promotion nor rejection evidence.

excluded_operational_smoke.purpose: Parser/runtime/cap sanity only; efficacy was discarded before execution.

locked_actor_test.purpose: This reciprocal full-actor test alone can promote the role-coherent continuation method.
locked_actor_test.inspection_rule: Do not inspect or publish any efficacy result until every shard in both orientations has completed and the raw merge succeeds.
locked_actor_test.combination: Invert block two to the candidate perspective, then equal-weight the two independent reciprocal blocks. Combined SE is sqrt(SE1^2 + SE2^2) / 2.
promotion_gate: combined candidate match score minus 1.645 standard errors exceeds 0.5
candidate match-score point estimate exceeds 0.5 in each reciprocal orientation
all recorded raw shards reopen, hash, and exactly remerge to the submitted block summaries
zero cap-terminated rounds, incomplete shards, gaps, overlaps, malformed rows, provenance mismatches, or operational errors

claim_limits: The two changed fields jointly validate one coherent discovery-plus-confirmation method; the result cannot attribute gain to either field alone.
The method is temporally and role coherent but still samples one balanced policy orientation per player rather than evaluating the exact 20-way ensemble at every continuation node.
A failed gate means not promoted; it does not prove equality or inferiority unless the reported confidence interval supports that narrower statement.
Exploratory, operational, parent-test, policy-only, or viewer-review observations are never pooled into this estimate.
reporting: Report each reciprocal orientation and the equal-weight candidate result: match score and pair-clustered SE, point margin and SE, W/L/D, cap count, total pairs, elapsed time, model/arena/source/plan/parent-result hashes, compiler, and exact actor specifications.
Retain every integer pair row plus complete footer and a canonical merged-row SHA-256.
Report the selected root symmetry and the parent-test artifact that mechanically selected it.
